newsitem.title: USA: Eastman Chemical mulls venture in China.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Chemical mulls venture in China.

text.p: Eastman Chemical Co and Yangzi Petrochemical Industrial Corp said they signed an agreement to study forming a joint venture in China.
The companies are considering building two plants in Nanjing, one to produce hydrocarbon tackifying resins and the other to manufacture sorbates, the companies said.
They did not reveal a target date for a decision or other details of the possible joint venture.

"Yangzi Petrochemical Industrial Corp has the raw materials for these products and is in a strategic location for supplying both the Chinese and global marketplace," said J. Brian Ferguson, Eastman's managing director of Greater China.
Yangzi Petrochemical is a unit of Sinopec Yangzi Petrochemical Corp in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.
